quotes:
A `GET` request's other fields are its query's, a
`POST` request's the fields of its `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
body, or of the upload's multipart head. Every other field is a row of the
data provider's `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS` (`OwnerFormField`). A row's `name` is
the field's name: its path in the `OwnerRequest` or `OwnerValues` it fills
(`carrier`), parts joined by a full stop, with a tuple's position written
where the row holds `OWNER_FORM_POSITION_MARK` (`#`), as decimal digits
from 0. A row's `reads_as` says how the field's text is read: as the text
itself, an integer's decimal digits, `true` or `false`, or an enumeration

discriminator chooses the variant.

quotes:
`module:upload_framing`. Read an upload's multipart head alone, so that its
CSRF value travels in the form and the file reaches `migration_import`
unread (A13 rules 5, 7; owner, 2026-11-17).

The CSRF value the first part carries, the delimiter that ends the file
part, and the file part's declared length — the request's declared length
less the head it read and the closing delimiter with its final `--` and line
end, or none when the request declared none; or that the head is not of that form — no multipart content type or
boundary, a first part that is not the CSRF field, no second part that is
the file — or is longer than the imported `UPLOAD_FORM_HEAD_MAX_BYTES`
constant, or declares less than that head and the closing delimiter, or the
request's stream fails or ends while the head is read — with none of these
values. The file part's stream is a `MultipartFileBody`, the class
`upload_framing` owns that implements `UploadBody` (State 6); it fails
when the request's stream ends before the closing delimiter, which
`migration_import.read_import_mapping` refuses as `file_unreadable`, as any
stream that fails — unless more than the limit had already been read, which
is `file_too_large` (A19 rule 4, restated 2026-11-24).
judgement.why: The later API makes the file the positional second multipart part handled as an unread MultipartFileBody by upload_framing, not a textual OWNER_FORM_FIELDS value.

itself, an integer's decimal digits, `true` or `false`, or an enumeration
member's value. A union's fields are the rows of all its variants, and its
discriminator chooses the variant. A field the form leaves out is none,

quotes:
The target is the query parameter
`OWNER_TARGET_PARAMETER` (`target`) names, an identity and never a
personal value (R0-29). A `GET` request's other fields are its query's, a
`POST` request's the fields of its `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
body, or of the upload's multipart head. Every other field is a row of the
data provider's `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS` (`OwnerFormField`).

author_guidance: Before editing, identify the decision's owning state from the phase purpose, question_scope and layer obligations, then choose a disposition for each topic that awaits one.
fixed: repair a decision the owning state must make; do not add later-layer implementation choices merely to close a topic. Record the fix commit and review the changed text once.

carried: name the receiving layer and use --what to preserve the choice, its options and consequences, and the required guarantee every option must keep. Decide any guarantee owned here before carrying its execution onward.
accepted: explain why the remaining choice is permitted. Bring an unresolved product choice to the owner with its options and consequences; absence of a quoted requirement does not decide it.
contradiction and standard_violation take no disposition: repair the offending text in its owning state and review the change. Deterministic transition findings must also close through their checks.
